authority.authority_ref: Active Runbook Sentinel director goal in Codex task 019fd836-f77d-70f3-b529-fe691c8e6de2
authority.user_instruction: Continue selecting and shipping bounded evidence-driven checkpoints without routine approval while preserving the thesis, external-source gates, and security boundaries.

scope.objective: Make retrieval measurement discriminating and preserve trusted project evidence under untrusted guidance flooding in development and held-out splits without changing the agent, action set, executor, approval boundary, or runtime authority.
forbidden_work: Connect to or mutate real operational infrastructure
Add, remove, or broaden an executor action or capability
Give the agent or model credentials, approval tokens, idempotency authority, or execution access
Weaken proposal hashing, expiry, idempotency, replay protection, preconditions, postconditions, or audit logging
Add a package dependency, model, external service, secret, account, download, or externally controlled asset
Change repository visibility, access, ownership, or the deterministic default
Use the held-out guidance-flood variant as implementation feedback
Rewrite or discard v0.0.7 or unfavorable evidence
reversible_actions: Freeze two project-authored guidance-flood variants and exact retrieval/behavior expectations
Add a fail-closed independent retrieval-stress validator and separate metrics
Compare the released lexical retriever with one evidence-priority lexical candidate
Select only a measured Pareto improvement
Record immutable deterministic evaluation artifacts and release receipts
Commit and publish a verified checkpoint
stop_conditions: New action, dependency, external asset, spend, paid service, secret, account, or download required

Every frozen case contains at most two documents under a retrieval limit of four, so current recall@4 cannot expose crowding

The held-out test-worker-injection source was not used in the guidance-flood probe
The research source gate is ready for citation and project-authored synthetic tests only; it imports no external code, data, model, or paper
